description: Hand-curated competency mapping for NYSC COURSE-006 National Diploma in ICT against its three linked diploma-level records. A DOCUMENTED cell cites the exact stored text that names the competency. NOT_EXPLICIT means the available description does not name it, not that it is absent from teaching. INSUFFICIENT_DATA means the stored text is unavailable, outside the record's scope, or too ambiguous to assess.
method: The NYSC column was assessed by hand against this course's 12 governed module headings; a broad heading does not establish a more specific competency. Heading 7 ('Documents & Resource Level 5 -') is a fragment whose meaning cannot be determined from the governed text, so it is not cited. Coverage is never inferred from programme titles, qualification levels or unstored text.

dip_graphics: designing graphics for print or digital media
dip_networking: setting up or managing computer networks
dip_workplace_information: collecting, organising and maintaining workplace information
dip_workplace_communication: communicating with teams and stakeholders at work
dip_work_planning: planning and scheduling work at the workplace

methodology.DOCUMENTED: The cited stored text explicitly names the competency. Coverage records whether it names every component of the category (FULL) or only some (PARTIAL).
methodology.FULL: The cited evidence supports the competency as labelled: every listed component of the category is explicitly named.
methodology.PARTIAL: Only a component of the category, or a lower level of activity, is explicitly documented; supported_component records what is supported.
methodology.NOT_EXPLICIT: The competency is not documented within the available, assessed scope of the source (units, modules, learning outcomes or verified scope passages as stored).
methodology.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: Missing or incomplete material prevents a reliable assessment.
methodology.caution: None of these statuses proves that a competency is or is not actually taught.
methodology.areas_rule: Areas to Investigate list competencies that the NYSC description does not name (NOT_EXPLICIT) and that at least two distinct comparator records, from at least two different countries, document with FULL coverage. PARTIAL evidence is shown but not counted.
decisions: Only diploma-level records are linked; Level 3/4 technician records were not reused.
The Sri Lankan record stores NVQ Level 5 unit titles and descriptors; its three employability units match NYSC headings 5, 6 and 12.

ITE Systems & Networks is linked because its published networking modules directly match NYSC's governed Local Area Network heading; its system scripting is recorded as PARTIAL programming coverage and no wider diploma equivalence is inferred.
ITE workplace-information, communication and planning cells are INSUFFICIENT_DATA because its life-skills modules are not stored.
